Long_Description: Psychic level 1 — In your Shooting phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked. Otherwise, this unit’s ranged attacks have +6" Range until the end of the phase.

Short_Description: MOVEMENT end → objective is secured.
Long_Description: At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured.

Short_Description: UNIT +1 OC.
Long_Description: This unit has +1 OC.

Short_Description: Within range of objective — MELEE +1 A.
Long_Description: While this unit is within range of an objective, this unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.

Short_Description: Within range of objective — attacks with S greater than UNIT T have -1 To Wound.
Long_Description: While this unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target this unit with a Strength greater than this unit’s Toughness have -1 to wound rolls.

Short_Description: Within 3" friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE → LONE OPERATIVE.
Long_Description: While this model is within 3" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit, this unit has Lone Operative.

Short_Description: MOVEMENT start/end — VEHICLE within 3" Heal D3; ignore Hit/Wound modifiers until next MOVEMENT.
Long_Description: In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this model’s move, you can select one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 3" of this model. That VEHICLE model heals D3 wounds. That VEHICLE model’s attacks can ignore modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls until the start of your next Movement phase.

Short_Description: CHARGE this turn — MELEE [+1 S] [+1 AP]
Long_Description: If this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit’s melee attacks have +1 S and AP.

Short_Description: Plasma Incinerator and Plasma Pistol — +1 to hazard rolls.
Long_Description: This unit has +1 to hazard rolls made for its Plasma Incinerator and Plasma Pistol weapons.

Short_Description: Bearer has 5+ InvS. [INVULNERABLE SAVE 5+]
Long_Description: This model has 5+ InvS.

Short_Description: UNIT has Deep Strike. [DEEP STRIKE]
Long_Description: This unit has Deep Strike.

Short_Description: Opponent FIGHT end — if unengaged, place UNIT in Strategic Reserves.
Long_Description: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if this unit is unengaged, you can place this unit in Strategic Reserves.

Short_Description: 12 ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY; cannot transport GRAVIS, JUMP PACK or TERMINATOR.
Long_Description: This model has a transport capacity of 12 ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY models. It cannot transport GRAVIS, JUMP PACK or TERMINATOR models.

Short_Description: UNIT has Scouts 6".
Long_Description: This unit has Scouts 6".

Short_Description: Once per phase — Fire Overwatch can target UNIT again; unmodified Hit rolls of 4+ hit until resolved.
Long_Description: Once per phase, per unit — You can target this unit with the Fire Overwatch stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do, this unit’s snap shooting attacks hit on unmodified hit rolls of 4+ until that stratagem is resolved. That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

Short_Description: RANGE — re-roll one Hit roll and one Wound roll.
Long_Description: This unit’s ranged attacks can re-roll one hit roll and re-roll one wound roll.

Short_Description: RANGE vs unit within 12" — [LETHAL HITS].
Long_Description: This unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 12" of this unit have [LETHAL HITS].

Short_Description: RANGE vs unit within 12" — [DEVASTATING WOUNDS — non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].
Long_Description: This unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 12" of this unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS — non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].

Short_Description: Transport 14 ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY; no JUMP PACK; GRAVIS/TERMINATOR count as 2.
Long_Description: This model has a transport capacity of 14 ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK models. Each GRAVIS or TERMINATOR model takes up the space of 2 models.

Short_Description: Transport 16 ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY; no JUMP PACK; GRAVIS/TERMINATOR count as 2.
Long_Description: This model has a transport capacity of 16 ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK models. Each GRAVIS or TERMINATOR model takes up the space of 2 models.

Short_Description: BATTLE start — mark enemy; attacks vs mark [RE-ROLL 1S TO WOUND]; when mark destroyed, select new enemy.
Long_Description: At the start of the first battle round, you can select one enemy unit to be this unit’s mark. This unit’s attacks that target this unit’s mark can re-roll wound rolls of 1. Each time this unit’s mark is destroyed, select one enemy unit to be this unit’s mark.

Short_Description: SHOOTING — after UNIT shoots, select MONSTER/VEHICLE hit; friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES RANGE attacks vs it have +1 AP.
Long_Description: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit hit by those attacks. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units’ ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have +1 AP.

Short_Description: Ranged vs non-MONSTER/VEHICLE — +1 AP.
Long_Description: Each time this unit makes a ranged attack that targets a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units), improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Short_Description: Ranged target within 12" — +1 Strength.
Long_Description: Each time this unit makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12" of this unit, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

Ability Name: Tactical Fluidity (Once per battle round, per unit)
Short_Description:
SHOOTING — after shooting while unengaged, Normal Move D6".
FIGHT (enemy) — if engaged, Fall Back 6".
Long_Description:
In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
Or — At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if this unit is engaged, this unit can make a Fall Back move of up to 6".

Short_Description: Re-roll Charge rolls for this unit [RE-ROLL CHARGE]
Long_Description: You can re-roll Charge rolls for this unit.
